topics.title: TrainTok puts railways in the spotlight
topics.summary: British train videos on TikTok have surged, with creators and rail workers sharing route tips, station history and practical travel advice. The trend is turning everyday transport into a lively online niche.
topics.discussionPrompt: What ordinary thing could you happily watch a whole stream of explainers about: buses, grocery stores, elevators, weather maps, kitchens, or something completely different?

topics.title: Sam Fender responds to ticket-price concerns
topics.summary: Sam Fender said prices for his 2027 stadium tour would be changed after fans objected. He also criticized tiered standing areas, reopening a wider conversation about what live music should cost.
topics.discussionPrompt: What would make a concert feel worth splashing out on: a favorite artist, a tiny venue, great seats, no hidden fees, or the chance to bring the whole friend group?

topics.title: Bayeux Tapestry draws a younger crowd
topics.summary: Tickets for the Bayeux Tapestry exhibition at the British Museum sold quickly, with bank data indicating strong interest from people under 35. The thousand-year-old artwork is having an unexpected pop-culture moment.
topics.discussionPrompt: Which old thing deserves a surprise comeback: maps, handwritten letters, arcade cabinets, record players, public fountains, or a museum exhibit you would actually queue for?

topics.title: AI music-training lawsuit spotlights copyright
topics.summary: Authentic Brands Group has sued Anthropic, alleging the company used hundreds of Elvis Presley songs to train AI systems. The case adds to the ongoing debate about creative work and training data.
topics.discussionPrompt: If an AI learned from every song you loved, what rule would feel fairest: permission first, payment later, automatic credit, no music training at all, or something else?

topics.title: Pegasus gets an easy stargazing moment
topics.summary: The bright stars of Pegasus are especially easy to spot in the evening sky right now. Its famous Great Square offers a simple starting point for anyone wanting to learn a new constellation.
topics.discussionPrompt: If you could rename a constellation after something modern, what would it be: The Coffee Mug, The Wi-Fi Symbol, The Skateboard, or your own wildly dramatic invention?

topics.title: Volkswagen plans a new US Audi factory
topics.summary: Volkswagen says it will invest $4 billion in an Audi SUV factory in Georgia, creating thousands of jobs. The move comes as the automaker manages global competition, tariffs and its costly shift toward electric vehicles.
topics.discussionPrompt: If you could design a car factory of the future, what would you insist it include: rooftop gardens, repair cafés, robot tours, quiet zones, or a way to recycle every scrap?

topics.title: Apprenticeship funding raises age questions
topics.summary: Employers warn that higher training costs for workers over 25 could complicate plans to tackle youth unemployment. The proposal has renewed debate about how apprenticeship support should be shared across generations.
topics.discussionPrompt: If you could learn any practical skill for free this year, what would you pick: cooking, coding, carpentry, languages, first aid, fixing bikes, or something wonderfully niche?

topics.title: Retail employers expand paternity leave
topics.summary: A report says retail employers are increasingly offering more generous paternity leave, while campaigners urge broader improvements. The story highlights how workplace policies can shape family time in those early weeks.
topics.discussionPrompt: What workplace benefit would improve everyday life most: flexible hours, more leave, a shorter week, free meals, a quiet room, or time set aside to learn something new?

topics.title: Bank of England rate outlook stays uncertain
topics.summary: City economists say UK interest rates may not reach 4.75% next summer and could later fall. Their forecasts reflect uncertainty around inflation, growth and the path of future borrowing costs.
topics.discussionPrompt: When money feels uncertain, which small habit makes you feel most organized: a budget, cooking at home, comparison shopping, saving automatically, or avoiding spreadsheets entirely?

topics.title: A tech-funding warning rattles AI markets
topics.summary: In a live business update, Elon Musk warned that some AI cloud-computing companies could struggle as funding tightens. The comments reflect wider questions about which parts of the fast-growing AI sector can last.
topics.discussionPrompt: Which future tech would you actually use every day if it worked perfectly: a smart helper, instant translation, a home robot, a better transit app, or something nobody has invented yet?
